'''Ana Maria Leal-Zanchet''' (born 20 January 1966) is a Brazilian [[zoologist]] and academic.

== Academic career ==

Leal-Zanchet obtained her first academic degree at the [[Universidade do Estado do Rio Grande do Norte]].{{cn|date=November 2026}} She subsequently earned a master's degree in zoology from the [[Pontifical Catholic University of Rio Grande do Sul]].<ref name="researchgate">{{cite web |url=https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Ana_Leal-Zanchet |title=Ana Leal-Zanchet (profile) |website=ResearchGate |access-date=30 December 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://professores.unisinos.br/ana-maria-leal-zanchet/ |title=Ana Maria Leal Zanchet |website=University of Vale do Rio dos Sinos |date=3 July 2020 |access-date=30 December 2020}}</ref>

Between 1991 and 1995, she undertook doctoral studies in Special Zoology at the [[University of Tübingen]] in Germany, where she received her doctorate in 1995.<ref name="researchgate" /><ref name="peerj">{{cite web |url=https://peerj.com/LealZanchet/ |title=Ana M Leal-Zanchet |website=PeerJ |access-date=30 December 2020}}</ref>

Following her doctorate, Leal-Zanchet took up a teaching position at the [[University of Vale do Rio dos Sinos]] (UNISINOS) in Brazil.<ref name="publons">{{cite web |url=https://publons.com/researcher/2701993/ana-maria-leal-zanchet/ |title=Ana Maria Leal-Zanchet |website=Publons |access-date=30 December 2020}}</ref>

=== Research ===

At UNISINOS, Leal-Zanchet leads a research group dedicated to [[land planarian]]s (Planárias) and a histology laboratory.<ref name="dgp">{{cite web |url=http://dgp.cnpq.br/dgp/espelhogrupo/6555268385566444 |title=Grupo de pesquisa Planárias |trans-title=Planarian Research Group |website=National Council for Scientific and Technological Development (CNPq) |access-date=30 December 2020}}</ref><ref name="researchgate" />

Her research focuses on the [[taxonomy|systematics]], functional [[morphology (biology)|morphology]], and ecology of planarians.<ref name="peerj" />

The work of her research group has contributed to the first descriptions of more than 40 species. Among the taxa described through this research are the land planarian species ''[[Cratera aureomaculata]]'' and ''[[Cratera nigrimarginata]]'',<ref name="noticias">{{cite web |last=Machado |first=Michelli |date=12 January 2017 |url=http://www.unisinos.br/noticias/pos-graduacao/novas-especies-de-planarias-sao-descobertas |title=Professora do Programa de Pós-Graduação em Biologia da Unisinos liderou a pesquisa |trans-title=Professor from the Unisinos Graduate Programme in Biology led the research |website=University of Vale do Rio dos Sinos |access-date=30 December 2020}}</ref> as well as the genera ''[[Difroehlichia]]''<ref name="Leal-Zanchet2018">{{cite journal |last1=Leal-Zanchet |first1=Ana Maria |last2=Marques |first2=Alessandro Damasceno |year=2018 |title=Coming out in a harsh environment: a new genus and species for a land flatworm (Platyhelminthes: Tricladida) occurring in a ferruginous cave from the Brazilian savanna |journal=PeerJ |volume=6 |article-number=e6007 |doi=10.7717/peerj.6007 |doi-access=free |pmid=30533305 |pmc=6284438 |bibcode=2018PeerJ...6e6007L }}</ref> and ''[[Supramontana]]''.<ref name="Carbayo2003">{{cite journal |last1=Carbayo |first1=Fernando |last2=Leal-Zanchet |first2=Ana Maria |year=2003 |title=Two new genera of geoplaninid land planarians (Platyhelminthes: Tricladida: Terricola) of Brazil in the light of cephalic specialisations |journal=Invertebrate Systematics |volume=17 |issue=3 |pages=449–468 |doi=10.1071/IT01035 |issn=1445-5226}}</ref>
